aggregation: Per-dimension median of three independent CLI scout judgments, then a common weighted sum. Ordinal judgments, not measured probabilities.
tie_policy: Equal composite scores retain equal competition ranks; presentation order uses validation, tractability, official ID. A tie at the third place must be reported.
caveats: Scouts share much primary literature and are not independent experimental replications.
Their definitions of tractability and validation emphasize different computational subproblems; median aggregation is a decision aid, not a measurement model.
A high score means useful bounded computational work is plausible; it does not estimate probability of solving the full experimental challenge.
